content.text: Localized collection of pus in breast tissue
MC in lactating women 2/2 nipple trauma (esp. primigravida)
Unilat breast pain (esp. one quadrant) w/ tenderness, warmth, swelling, fever
cracked nipples or visible fissure + induration and fluctuance (← pus)
– if question of cellulitis vs. abscess;
ill-defined mass w/ septations if abscess
Drainage via needle aspiration (lactational abscess) or I&D + abx
*⍉a contraindication to breast feeding – milk drainage = important to facilitate resolution of infect
Benign solid tumor composed of glandular & fibrous tissue
MC benign breast mass (after fibrocystic dz) & MC benign tumor in women <30yrs
but may become tender prior to menstruation
does ⍉Δ significantly in size w/ menstrual cycle
– most sm tumors resorb w/ time
: may be needed if enlarging after repeat U/S or for lrg masses
Noncancerous, fluid-filled breast cysts ← exaggerated response to hormones
– duct dilate, breast cysts, & stromal fibrosis
*MC benign breast dx in reprod age women (esp. 30-50yrs)
may ↑ or ↓ in size w/ menstrual hormonal chgs
, nodular, mobile, smooth round or ovoid lumps in both breasts of varying sizes
& USU ⍉assoc w/ axillary lymph node involvement
MC found in upper outer sections of the breast
– test of choice; dense, prominent, fibroglandular tissue w/ cysts but ⍉discernable mass
dry aspirate, blood aspirate, persistent/recurr mass after aspirate
: observation, supportive bra, ↓fat diet, reduce caffeine & chocolate intake, warm/cool compress, analgesics, Pm primrose oil or vit E
*FNA removal or fluid = diagnostic & therapeutic in complex cases
Infect of the breast MC in lactating women 2/2 nipple trauma (esp. primigravida in the first 6wks postpartum)
Unilat localized breast pain, tenderness, warmth, swelling, induration, & skin redness
Cx of breast milk – for sensitivities
Imaging – reserved for cases ⍉responding to empiric abx w.in 48-72hrs
: warm/cool compresses, breast pump, anti-inflam meds
•erythromycin can be used in PCN allergy
*Mothers encouraged to cont breastfeed – milk drainage = critical for resolution of infect & relief of sxs
